summary: The customer called because they were frustrated with slow and unstable internet and wanted to upgrade their plan immediately. The agent checked the account, explained the pricing and speed for a 100 Mbps fiber upgrade, and promised a technician visit for installation by tomorrow morning. The customer completed an SMS confirmation approval, and the agent successfully submitted the upgrade request.

evidence.text: وبنفس الوقت رح أبعثلك technician لعندك بكرة الصبح أقصى حد للتثبيت.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Send a technician for installation by tomorrow morning at the latest.

evidence.text: أنا رح أكتب ملاحظة خاصة عالتطلب إنه urgent عشان يلتزموا بالموعد بالزبط.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Add a special urgent note to the request to ensure they adhere to the appointment time.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، أكيد بفهم عليك، خلينا نشيك على الـ current package تبعتك

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite, calm, and professional demeanor throughout the call, even when the customer was frustrated.
